ModMetaData.name: Raider Approach Lag Fix
ModMetaData.author: OldManYoung
ModMetaData.description:
Reduces periodic stutters that can occur while hostile raiders approach a colony.
The vanilla high-value-item trigger repeatedly calculates MarketValue for the same nearby trees, stone chunks, and other objects. On heavily modded games, these repeated calculations can produce visible freezes.
This mod temporarily caches each object's calculated value for the duration of one synchronous raider steal scan. The cache is discarded immediately after the scan. It does not change the scan interval, search radius, stealing threshold, or intended target-selection behavior.
This alpha version includes optional lightweight diagnostic logging, disabled by default and configurable through the mod settings menu.
Requires Harmony.
This is unofficial community-created content and is not endorsed by Ludeon Studios.
